title: CityRiSE: Reasoning Urban Socio-Economic Status in Large Vision-Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2510.22282v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Urban socio-economic sensing plays a vital role in advancing global sustainable development goals. With the advent of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), new opportunities have emerged to address this challenge by framing it as a multi-modal perception and reasoning task. However, recent studies show that LVLMs still struggle to make accurate and interpretable socio-economic predictions from visual data. translated_title: CityRiSE：通过强化学习在大规模视觉语言模型中推理城市社会经济状况
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2510.22282v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：城市社会经济感知在推进全球可持续发展目标中发挥着至关重要的作用。随着大规模视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的出现，通过将其构建为多模态感知和推理任务，为解决这一挑战带来了新的机遇。然而，近期研究表明，LVLMs在从视觉数据中进行准确且可解释的社会经济预测方面仍存在困难。为了克服这些限制并充分发挥LVLMs的潜力，我们提出了CityRiSE，一种通过强化学习（RL）在LVLMs中推理城市社会经济状况的新框架。通过精心策划的多模态数据集和可验证的奖励设计，我们的方法引导LVLM关注语义上有意义的视觉线索，从而实现结构化和目标导向的推理，用于通用社会经济状况预测。实验表明，配备涌现推理能力的CityRiSE显著提升了性能。
tldr: 本文提出CityRiSE框架，利用强化学习和可验证奖励设计，引导大规模视觉语言模型关注语义视觉线索，从而显著提升城市社会经济状况的准确和可解释预测能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the CityRiSE framework, which leverages reinforcement learning with verifiable reward design to guide large vision-language models to focus on semantically meaningful visual cues, significantly improving accurate and interpretable urban socio-economic status prediction.
